MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Bring Him Home feels like a natural next choice because I want expressive musical theatre vocals, continuing what I enjoyed in Stages and A Musical Affair.",
    "Love Somebody fits the country side of my listening reflected in 747 and Golden, giving me another choice connected to an established interest."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Christmas Together, Holiday Wishes, and That's Christmas To Me connect to my past holiday listening, but I am not in a seasonal listening mood now.",
    "Storyteller and 25 do not connect strongly enough to the relaxing music and theatrical vocals I want on this visit.",
    "New Moves / Traces and Awakening are too unfamiliar for me to identify a personal connection, while enjoying some country music does not give me enough interest in Toby Keith to choose a large hits collection."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My previous Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing preference regardless of my current mood.",
    "My interest in some country albums seems to have been extended too broadly to other artists and collections without a stronger personal connection."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent listening points toward relaxation, and I would like choices that connect more clearly with that mood.",
    "The expressive vocal appeal linking Stages and A Musical Affair matters more to me right now than a loose connection to music I have listened to before."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my theatrical vocal and country interests, but give too much weight to past holiday listening and too little to my current desire for relaxing music and expressive singing."
}
